metadata.classification: synthetic engineering assumption; not validated aircraft-engine physics
metadata.purpose: Software architecture, simulation, and relative health indication only

sea_level_pressure_kpa.description: Reference pressure used only to normalize the density proxy.

reference_temperature_k.description: Reference temperature used only to normalize the density proxy.

humidity_density_weight.description: Small prototype correction representing lower moist-air density.

fallback_pressure_lapse_exponent.description: Standard-atmosphere-shaped fallback when pressure telemetry is unavailable; not local weather truth.

reported_load_weight.description: Weight assigned to reported engine load in the load proxy.

throttle_load_weight.description: Weight assigned to throttle corrected by density in the load proxy.

reference_rpm.description: Prototype normalization reference; not an operating limit.

fuel_flow_scale_lph.description: Prototype proportional fuel-flow scale; not a calibrated fuel map.

injection_base_deg.description: Prototype timing-map intercept; not an ECU command recommendation.

cht_stress_reference_c.description: Reference for relative thermal stress, not a safe/unsafe limit.

cht_stress_span_c.description: Scaling span for the dimensionless thermal indicator.

egt_stress_reference_c.description: Reference for relative exhaust thermal stress, not a limit.

egt_stress_span_c.description: Scaling span for exhaust thermal stress.

oil_pressure_reference_kpa.description: Prototype pressure health reference while running.

oil_temperature_reference_c.description: Reference for relative oil-temperature penalty, not a limit.

vibration_reference_rms.description: Prototype vibration-health reference; sensor bandwidth is not modeled.

nominal_efficiency_percent.description: Relative software-demonstrator efficiency baseline, not measured efficiency.

minimum_efficiency_percent.description: Display floor for the prototype efficiency proxy.

running_rpm_reference.description: Prototype switch for applying running-engine relationships.
